title: Columbia Mission: Countdown to Disaster
description: On February 1st, 2003, Space Shuttle Columbia disintegrated during re-entry, killing all seven astronauts onboard. The disaster began sixteen days earlier, when a piece of insulating foam struck the shuttle's wing during launch. Concerns were raised, but the risk was underestimated and no further action was taken. As Columbia returned to Earth, hidden damage led to catastrophic failure - revealing how a small warning, left unresolved, set the stage for tragedy.

title: Costa Concordia Disaster: Minute by Minute

The impact tore a fatal gash in the hull. Instead of ordering an immediate evacuation, Schettino fatally delayed the alarm and abandoned his sinking ship. The tragedy claimed 32 lives and forever changed maritime safety laws.
